name: ExportSupportBundle
transaction_boundary: candidate collection and current re-sanitization occur outside authoritative transaction; only successfully written/reopened/validated bundle gets one short command-receipt/audit UnitOfWork
guards: all included records pass current sanitizer/canary policy
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay never silently overwrites a different destination artifact
receipt_order: replay/preflight -> collect bounded candidates -> re-sanitize -> write temporary bundle -> reopen/verify -> atomically publish destination -> final evidence revalidation -> command_receipt -> audit/result refs -> commit
mutations: LLD-01 command receipt and security.support_bundle_exported audit/result evidence only; support-bundle bytes are external non-authoritative output
revision_effects: no application/domain/security entity revision is incremented by support export; committed replay records no new receipt/audit and increments nothing
post_commit_work: none; the published bundle is complete before authoritative export evidence commits
rules: domain database/audit/source workbooks/communications/working notes excluded by default
